Mystery Sheen, South Timbalier Block 23, LA

2012-04-29
The USCG Morgan City contacted the NOAA SSC this evening about a sheen in Timbalier Block 23. The sheen was reported to be a 2 mi X 100 ft silvery sheen heading NW. The location was about 6 miles from shore, to the southwest of Timbalier Bay. A trajectory analysis was requested.
